messages:
maya_peopleops: Heads-up: we released a condensed exception flow for this cycle (caregivers, new hires <90d, long-term illness). Please read: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/exception-flow :wave:
raj_manager: Quick Q: if I defer a new hire, should I still add manager notes?
maya_peopleops: Yes. Always add manager notes in People > Reviews > Notes. Defer means they won't go to calibration unless you request a provisional rating.
emi_engineering: What's the fastest way to get a 1-week extension for someone?
maya_peopleops: Use /review-extend @person <reason> for up to 2 weeks (auto-routes). For longer, use the full exception form.
noah_sre: Contractors: include in calibration or not?
maya_peopleops: Vendors use the vendor feedback template. To include in calibration, file an exception and cc maya_peopleops.
raj_manager: Any form changes? I get confused by competencies each cycle.
maya_peopleops: Minor tweak: competencies now 1-5; any 1 or 2 requires a short evidence sentence. Examples in the guide.
forms_bot: Reminder: review-forms v3 published. If stale, clear cache.
maya_peopleops: Deadlines: peers close 1939009000, managers due 1939015000. Calibration week 1939018000-1939022000. File exceptions ASAP.
